# ada-url / max_length

ada-url's own fuzz target `max_length` ([source](source/max_length.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over ada (ada-url/ada at e6754478).

Checks one property, an invariant: With ada::set_max_input_length(512), no parse, base-relative parse, fuzz-chosen setter sequence (up to 16 steps) or percent-encoding-expanding setter can yield get_href_size() > 512, for both ada::url and ada::url_aggregator.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against ada at commit e6754478.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.
